newsitem.title: USA: IPL Systems, ANDATACO to merge.
newsitem.headline: IPL Systems, ANDATACO to merge.

text.p: IPL Systems Inc and ANDATACO said Monday they had signed a letter of intent to merge.

Terms call for shareholders of ANDATACO to receive about three shares for each share of IPL outstanding on a fully diluted basis, resulting in the principal shareholder of ANDATACO becoming the controlling shareholder of the combined companies, the companies said in a joint statement.

The merger is subject to execution of a definitive agreement, a fairness opinion from IPL's financial adviser, approval by the directors and shareholders of both companies, and any regulatory approval.
Both companies are computer storage providers, focusing on complementary segments of the open systems market.
Massachusetts-based IPL designs, manufactures, sells and services computer storage solutions for worldwide users of UNIX platforms.

ANDATACO, based in San Diego, Calif., manufactures RAID and non-RAID storage products featuring its intelligent ESP (Enterprise Storage Packaging) self-monitoring enclosure technology, and distributes best-of-breed products from other manufacturers through its nationwide network of sales offices.
